description: Use for receptor questions: one receptor, ion channel or enzyme by name or gene (for example CB1, CNR1, TRPV1, GPR55, FAAH, CYP3A4): what it is, where it sits in the body, the compounds mapped to it with their action, effect and evidence grade, and every measured binding or functional value with species and PubMed identifiers. Educational reference, not medical advice. Example arguments: {"id":"CB1"}.
